about_the_game:
Locked in a fire and blood-covered medieval Basement 66

Beneath the earth, you sit across from a grinning figure cloaked in shadow. The basement smells of rot and sulfur. Between you sits a box—ancient, scarred, and engraved with strange symbols. The Devil invites you to play a simple game.

Roll the dice. Shut the numbers. Move forward.
But beware: in this game, whoever reaches the 66th field first dies.

In Basement 66, the classic dice game becomes a life-or-death duel. You and the Devil take turns playing a cursed version of “Shut the Box.” Every number shut pushes you forward on the board. The catch? If you reach the 66th field before the Devil does… you die. - In the Demo version Death would be sooner than reaching 66th field.

To survive, you must master the mechanics, manipulate luck, exploit cursed tiles, and outwit the Devil himself—who cheats, lies, and toys with you as the race goes on.

All while strange memories begin to surface… and the Basement 66 starts to feel more familiar than it should.

Core Gameplay:

  • Classic "Shut the Box" meets a Death Race
    Each shut tile adds to your movement. Reach 66 and you lose. Reach it second, and you win. Carefully balance your progress—advance too fast, and you'll seal your fate.

  • Play Against the Demon

  • Medieval Horror Setting

  • Procedural Horror & Replayable Design

    • Rooms subtly shift between games - In the Demo version, only 1st room is available,  

    • The Demon uses different tricks each time - The number of Demon's tactics is limited because it is a vertical slice of the game.

    • A little surprise once in a while - Demon will choose exactly when you'll receive it...

Key Features:

  • Physics-based dice rolling: Dice rolls are 100% physics-based, so it makes it more replayable.

  • Card Destruction: After each roll, there is a satisfying effect while destroying the cards

  • Tactical horror: You must plan moves carefully, choosing which numbers to shut.

  • Perma death: Only one of you will survive.

  • Surprise: You'll see...

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not suitable for all ages: Flashing Lights, Jumpscares, Blood, Violence, Death, General Mature Content

short_description: The dice roguelike. You’ve been locked in Basement 66 with the Demon. Roll the death dice. Destroy cursed cards. Remember, only one of you can leave this hell alive. Will you survive? Good luck…
